steps.en: Start a private control plane and router
steps.zh: 启动私有控制面和中继

steps.en: Declare a backend and enroll its node with a token file
steps.zh: 声明后端并用令牌文件让节点入网

steps.en: Issue a key-bound identity and announce the backend service
steps.zh: 签发密钥绑定身份并公告后端服务

steps.en: Send a request through a second node's local model API
steps.zh: 通过第二个节点的本地模型接口发请求

steps.en: Verify peers and policy, then route to the backend
steps.zh: 验证身份和策略，再路由到后端

value.en: Use a remote agent service without a fixed public backend address
value.zh: 无需固定公开后端地址，也能调用远端 agent 服务
